description: This file declares classes and methods for managing container instances, specifically CRunContainer and CRunContainerAdministrator, within the Thunder::ProcessContainers namespace. It includes external C libraries related to container management and defines interfaces for starting, stopping, and retrieving information about containers.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance with methods to start, stop, and retrieve container information.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages container instances, providing methods to create containers and configure logging.

methods.name: CRunContainer
methods.description: Constructor for CRunContainer, initializes container with name, path, and log path.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container with a specified timeout.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory information of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves processor information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves network interfaces associated with the container.

methods.name: OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Replaces container arguments with new command and parameters.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on ID and search paths.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Configures logging options for container management.
